notes.title: UPDATE: Mac'os Support live test
notes.notes:
[h2]What's new?[/h2]

- We are happy to announce we have built version for [b]Mac'os[/b] last time with success we introduce Linux version. All systems are compatible with each other. If you have Windows and your friend has Linux it's not a problem at all! You can still play together! 


Best Regards
Source Byte Sp. z o.o.
